reason: What was removed is the UMD browser bundle (dist/browser.umd.js) and its `mongoose/browser` entry, which mongoose 8.16.1 shipped without TypeScript declarations (importing it fails with TS7016 under strict), so no typed application API changes; it is a removed build format.

Query.use$geoWithin already defaulted to true in 8.16.1 (within() builds $geoWithin in both versions, checked with getFilter()), it only mattered for MongoDB < 2.4, and it is absent from 8.16.1's TypeScript types (TS2339), so no plausible typed application code sets it or sees a difference.

Only the timing and text of a utils.warn() message change (8.16.1 warns inside schema.index(), 9.11.2 when the model builds its indexes, which needs a database); the declared indexes (schema.indexes()) and all other behavior are the same, so this is logging only.

8.16.1 already had no Model.mapReduce() or geoSearch() (neither in lib/model.js nor in the Model types); only the orphaned MapReduceOptions and GeoSearchOptions interfaces were still exported, so no plausible application code uses them (checked 8.16.1 types/models.d.ts).

Checked offline with a subdocument pre('deleteOne') hook: the usual code (subdoc.deleteOne() then parent.save()) runs the hook before save() settles in both 8.16.1 and 9.11.2, so only code that calls subdoc.deleteOne() and never saves the parent sees a difference; a task built on that would grade an unsaved intermediate state, and 9's post hooks need a real database write.
